title: Use trimmed QF_UF clause logs and search assumptions by shared symbols
summary: The clause-log exporter now accepts declare-sort in trimmed logs, so trimmed QF_UF logs are used instead of falling back to the full log, and it ties assumed clauses only to conjuncts sharing an uninterpreted symbol on large inputs. Lean checking is unchanged, while NEQ004_size4 needs about a third of the resolution steps and one large input exports in about a second instead of 90.
